name: Vehicle Re-Identification Benchmark (Disentangled Feature Learning Network)
description: A comprehensive vehicle re-identification benchmark that measures model performance on identifying vehicles across cameras and conditions, alongside a proposed disentangled feature learning network.
general_score_metric: mAP (mean Average Precision) and Rank-1 accuracy
reputation: Widely cited within the vehicle re-identification community and used as a standard re-ID benchmark.
notes: Non-LLM vision benchmark; sensitive to viewpoint, occlusion, and cross-camera bias; possible privacy concerns (vehicle/identity).
